<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/promo.ts -->
<!--
  A thin strip above the page: an icon, one sentence, a link and an optional close button. Axes: tone (default,
  muted), layout (center, split), dismiss (show, hide).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type AnnouncementBarProps = {
    label: string;
    text: string;
    cta?: string;
    ctaHref?: string;
    icon?: string;
    dismissLabel: string;
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    layout?: "center" | "split";
    dismiss?: "show" | "hide";
    badgeLabel?: string;
    badge?: "none" | "show";
    position?: "top" | "bottom";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../primitives/link-plain/link-plain.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    label,
    text,
    cta,
    ctaHref,
    icon = "megaphone",
    dismissLabel,
    tone = "default",
    layout = "center",
    dismiss = "hide",
    badgeLabel,
    badge = "none",
    position = "top",
  }: AnnouncementBarProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="aside"
  class={cn(
    "w-full",
    (((position as string) === "bottom") ? "sticky bottom-0 z-40 border-t border-border" : ""),
    (
      (tone as string) === "muted" ? "bg-muted text-foreground"
      : "bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
    )
  )}
  aria-label={label}
  data-testid="announcement"
  data-layout={layout}
>
  <Container
    class={cn(
      "mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4",
      "flex items-center gap-4 py-2",
      (((layout as string) === "split") ? "justify-between" : "justify-center")
    )}
    data-slot="container"
  >
    <Group
      gap="4"
      align="center"
      class={cn(
        "min-w-0 flex-wrap",
        ((((layout as string) === "center") && ((dismiss as string) === "show")) ? "ml-auto" : "")
      )}
    >
      <LucideIcon name={icon} size={16} />
      {#if ((badge as string) === "show")}
        <Inline
          class="rounded px-2 py-0 text-xs font-semibold inset-ring inset-ring-current"
          data-testid="announcement-badge"
        >
          {badgeLabel}
        </Inline>
      {/if}
      <Text size="sm">
        {text}
      </Text>
      {#if cta}
        <LinkPlain
          href={ctaHref}
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold underline underline-offset-4"
          data-testid="announcement-cta"
        >
          {cta}
          <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
        </LinkPlain>
      {/if}
    </Group>
    {#if ((dismiss as string) === "show")}
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        class="ml-auto shrink-0 text-current"
        type="button"
        aria-label={dismissLabel}
        data-testid="dismiss"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="x" size={16} />
      </Button>
    {/if}
  </Container>
</Block>
